name: 08-24-p1-metrics-sse-bounded-observability
title: P1: bounded HTTP metrics window, SSE backpressure budget, and runtime observability
description: Eliminate the two remaining request-driven OOM risk classes from the frozen OOM remediation plan (a9f9eec) and add lightweight runtime observability: /api/metrics/agent requires a complete <=31-day window and must not retain unbounded raw rows; SSE applies a per-client 2 MiB combined budget with 5s per-blocked-episode drain deadline; add heap/RSS, turn/queue/invocation, and SSE buffer counters. Offline CLI keeps explicit unbounded mode.
creator: GLM
notes: Base develop@b87295478dee9bdd3cd54caad9c6a5dbe65e4a82 (includes P0 merge 2afa667 + archive b872954). Contract source: frozen plan a9f9eec P1A/P1B sections plus performance acceptance matrix. Non-goals: P2 targeted queries / prompt window / modelUsage cap / snapshot table; production data/config/process changes; heap limit increase; production heap snapshots; merge before user acceptance.
